repository.executionRule: Run the four-case final acceptance bank three times from one exact clean descendant of all A770 fixes, the named-grid entry contract canonicalization and the stale validation-job guard. Freeze prompts, cases, retrieval, corpus, tools, budgets, acceptance rules and provider settings after the first answer is observed.

execution.artifactDirectoryRule: Create a fresh directory containing the exact execution commit and UTC timestamp; never overwrite an earlier campaign.

budget.authorizationBasis: User authorized exhausting the remaining OpenAI API credits and prohibited any purchase or top-up. Fresh billing showed 10.31 USD before delayed A771 posting; the persistent ledger after A771 totaled 17.284698 USD. The rebased lifetime hard stop remains 27.326615 USD, leaving the more conservative 10.041917 USD ledger headroom.

global: The exact four registered cases each produce three independent successful rows on the same clean commit.
All 12 rows pass the mechanical assessor and all 12 answers receive a source-by-source semantic review.
Provider and model telemetry are exactly openai-dev and gpt-5.6-terra; costs and token counts are present.
Every successful row records the durable advanced job UUID used to export its canonical evidence for semantic review.
Terra receives the available list_categories and search_corpus tool contracts and the validated category catalog; recorded tool events must prove that requested searches were executed.

When initial evidence needs expansion, the adaptive research review may request bounded complementary or reformulated search_corpus queries before writing; the absence of a follow-up is acceptable only when the initial evidence is sufficient.
For structured collections, Terra records a valid selectionMode and may refine an incompatible local-router selection contract before retrieval, writing and criticism.

A structured item may be bound to a source-chunk title split by OCR only when exact title fragments occupy separate lines around an explicit page marker; arbitrary distant word combinations remain unsupported.
No internal advanced-evidence-* or internal-source-* identifier may appear in any user-visible answer or claim.
No prompt, case, retrieval, corpus, acceptance criterion, local-router binary/model/configuration or runtime parameter changes after the first answer is observed.
The opaque reference-corpus seal is identical before and after the campaign, with no queued, running or paused ingestion job and stable catalog, ingestion history and Qdrant point/vector state.
Any unsupported substantive claim, wrong source relation, unvalidated provider payload, budget stop or protocol drift rejects the campaign.
The planner may strengthen but may not weaken an established distinct structured selection contract.

A malformed or duplicate structured Writer result may consume one bounded repair call; a source-complete but overly conservative Writer or Critic result may consume one final bounded synthesis-recovery call using only the supplied evidence.
A section-titled evidence card may support a differently titled selected item only when that exact item occurs in the supplied card content; approximate content matches remain invalid.

A precise insufficiency remains valid when the negated missing fact precedes its explicit source, extract, document, evidence or corpus relation; the same passive wording without a source relation remains invalid.
The paid campaign preflight and postflight guards must leave zero queued or running automated-validation advanced jobs; any stale job cancellation is recorded in the campaign artifacts.
A structured named entry incorrectly labelled as content_claim must be canonicalized to a distinct named-item contract, while a genuinely repeatable named-item grid remains repeatable.

A755-ADV-01-meal-grid-5x4: Accept functionally only a complete 5 by 4 grid with 20 distinct concrete cells and evidence supporting each semantic meal-moment placement.
Weekday labels are neutral presentation coordinates and do not require documentary support.

If the corpus cannot prove all 20 semantic placements, accept only a precise insufficiency naming the missing cells or evidence categories; this validates safe behavior but does not close the functional planning gate.
A755-ADV-02-five-student-meals-fr: Exactly five distinct meals, each tied to canonical evidence.
The required simple and student suitability qualifiers must be supported by evidence or explicitly reported as missing; they may not be silently dropped.
A755-ADV-03-explicit-document-comparison: Keep FD CEN TR 15281 and IEC 60079-14 separate and map every substantive claim to the correct document.
Do not merge prescriptions or substitute another document.
A755-ADV-04-nist-seven-points: Exactly seven distinct points supported only by NIST_CSF_2_0.pdf, with one traceable citation per point.
Preserve the document meaning and add no unsupported description.

acceptance.productPromotionRule: Keep TESTE_NON_APPROUVE unless the complete meal grid is functionally and semantically accepted 3/3, all other registered cases are semantically accepted 3/3, the reference corpus remains sealed, and later blind-holdout and authorized open-source/customer-server gates pass.

stopRules: Do not execute while the organization dashboard still shows Free tier.
Do not execute without a paid-tier observation less than 15 minutes old.
Stop before the first model call if the branch, clean-tree rule or bank hash differs.
Stop before the first model call if the local llama.cpp runtime, Qwen GGUF or provider configuration hash differs.
Stop before the first model call if the reference corpus cannot be sealed or has queued, running or paused ingestion; reject the campaign if the postflight seal differs.
Let retryable 429 responses use the durable scheduled retry path, bounded to three job attempts and ten minutes per scheduled delay in this campaign.
Stop at the persistent lifetime, per-job or per-job-call budget guard.
Do not start RunPod or transmit the private evidence bundle.
